'''Product Relations''' was a subdivision of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority's]] [[Media Division]]. It was responsible for molding and controlling the feelings of the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector's]] residents, as well as marketing the Authority to outside interests. Public Relations dealt with the public service campaigns run throughout the Sector for the benefit of the residents, as well as advertising campaigns for Authority products in the larger galaxy. Public Relations also dealt with disgruntled ex-employees who publicly berated and badmouthed the Authority.<ref name="HSCS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>
